name: smwgraphics-robo-yoshi
title: Robo-Yoshi
description:
Straight from my hack Mafia Mario is my custom made Robo-Yoshi.

With thrusters near his wheels and a claw-grip tongue, Robo-Yoshi is the best form of Prehistoric transportation on the market today.When Robo-Yoshi has something in his mouth his pupils glow orange, and when he swallows things the lava-like acidin his body disolves anything in a matter of seconds! Feed him enough fruit and you might get a surprise...

Robo-Yoshi doesn't use a custom palette but I don't know which one he uses...
